name: TCA cycle
summary: Mitochondrial matrix. Per acetyl-CoA: 3 NADH, 1 FADH₂, 1 GTP, 2 CO₂ (≈10 ATP). Irreversible: citrate synthase, isocitrate dehydrogenase (rate-limiting), α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase. “Citrate Is Krebs' Starting Substrate For Making Oxaloacetate.”

oaa.name: Oxaloacetate
oaa.notes: Regenerated each turn; also the gluconeogenic entry point (via PEPCK) and the source of aspartate.

citrate.name: Citrate
citrate.notes: Exported to the cytosol for fatty acid synthesis (citrate shuttle); activates acetyl-CoA carboxylase and F-1,6-BPase, inhibits PFK-1.

succoa.name: Succinyl-CoA
succoa.notes: Also the entry point for odd-chain fatty acids (via propionyl-CoA → methylmalonyl-CoA, needs B12) and the starting material for heme.

fumarate.name: Fumarate
fumarate.notes: Also produced by the urea cycle (argininosuccinate lyase) and purine synthesis.

malate.name: Malate
malate.notes: Carries OAA carbon out of the mitochondrion for gluconeogenesis (malate shuttle).

cs.name: Citrate synthase
cs.notes: Acetyl-CoA + OAA condensation. Inhibited by ATP, NADH, succinyl-CoA, citrate.

aconitase.name: Aconitase
aconitase.notes: Isomerizes via cis-aconitate; iron–sulfur enzyme. Inhibited by fluorocitrate (from fluoroacetate).

idh.name: Isocitrate dehydrogenase
idh.notes: Rate-limiting. Activated by ADP and Ca²⁺; inhibited by ATP and NADH. First NADH and CO₂ of the cycle.

akgdh.name: α-Ketoglutarate dehydrogenase
akgdh.notes: Same cofactors as pyruvate dehydrogenase: B1 (TPP), B2 (FAD), B3 (NAD⁺), B5 (CoA), lipoic acid (“Tender Loving Care For Nancy”). Inhibited by succinyl-CoA, NADH, ATP; arsenite blocks lipoic acid.

scs.name: Succinyl-CoA synthetase
scs.notes: The only substrate-level phosphorylation in the cycle (GTP).

sdh.name: Succinate dehydrogenase
sdh.notes: Embedded in the inner membrane — it is complex II of the electron transport chain. FAD is covalently bound. Competitively inhibited by malonate.

fumarase.name: Fumarase
fumarase.notes: Adds water across the double bond. Deficiency → hereditary leiomyomatosis and renal cell cancer.

mdh.name: Malate dehydrogenase
mdh.notes: Thermodynamically uphill; pulled forward by citrate synthase consuming OAA.
